name: Metal Coatings (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Metal Coatings (India) Ltd is engaged in the manufacture and sale of Cold Rolled Steel Coils/Strips and H.R. Pickled & Oiled Coils/strips.
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
a) Mcil Cold Rolled Steel Coils
b) Mcil Cold Rolled Steel Strips
c) Mcil HRPO Steel Strips
d) Mcil Hrpo Steel Coils

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.82% over past five years.
